339-574-677-5223.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-5223.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

147-3899-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3899-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1626-2466-3249--206.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Headless Rider triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that Zombie from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.
728-1626-2466-3249--206.notes: Some of the one-drop Zombie creatures in the template adds more powerful results, and Gravecrawler does not require Havengul Lich.

3899-4871-5695-6019.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit abilities from steps 3 and 7
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-2981-3375-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-3375-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7933.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cold-Blooded Crew.
When Cold-Blooded Crew dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cold-Blooded Crew enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1379-5147-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-5147-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Goblin Bombardment.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4460-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1263-1417-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a type chosen that matches a type of the persist creature

345-5147--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat

1995-2097-3809-4917.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two other artifact creatures.
1995-2097-3809-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Jolene
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}{W} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Jolene
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}{W} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.
1995-2097-3809-4917.notes: Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you can use Jan Jansen's second ability, paired with untapping it, infinitely to get infinite Construct tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

206-1719-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

457-1329-2099-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.
457-1329-2099-7340.notes: If you control an artifact creature, it can be untapped by the second Sewer-veillance Cam trigger, and then tapped via Urza to get infinite blue mana. Once you have infinite blue mana, you can either use it for Urza's second ability and/or to activate Sewer-veillance Cam's ability to draw cards.

1417-2921-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-2921-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

222-527-4742-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4742-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

628-2921-7195.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Chaos Spewer.
When Chaos Spewer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chaos Spewer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

394-2034-4772-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
394-2034-4772-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

862-2173-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1603-2228-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Evil Twin.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evil Twin by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

2511-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
2511-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

527-2011.easyPrerequisites: Selvala, Heart of the Wilds does not have summoning sickness.
527-2011.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Selvala vigilance.
You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
527-2011.description:
Declare Selvala as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1003-4452-5852.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
1003-4452-5852.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Walker triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Phyrexian Walker spells, causing the nontoken Phyrexian Walker to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

2038-2557-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kozilek's Predator.
When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

307-3403-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Ingenious Infiltrator and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Ingenious Infiltrator or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
307-3403-3542.description:
Declare Palinchron and Ingenious Infiltrator as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Ingenious Infiltrator from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Ingenious Infiltrator's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Ingenious Infiltrator onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

311-4424-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
311-4424-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Coral Trickster.
When Coral Trickster dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Coral Trickster from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Coral Trickster's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Coral Trickster triggers, untapping target permanent.
Repeat.

539-1778-3470-4300.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Memnite to your hand from the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token with flying.
Repeat.

751-877.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake for {0}.Shrieking Drake triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

3575-4381-5297.description:
Activate Sarkhan first loyalty ability by putting one loyalty counters on it, Sarkhan becomes a Legendary 4/4 red Dragon creature with flying, indestructible, and haste until end of turn.
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrificing itself.
Aerie Ouphes' persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Aerie Ouphes ability, dealing damage equal to its power to Sarkhan.
Repeat.
